data.name: Heading
data.value: Recorded permissions - not an effective access check

data.name: Boundary
data.value: Entire captured forest, AD objects only. Only entries naming the selected SID are included. Permissions through other groups, SID history and implicit owner rights are not included. An Allow entry does not prove the operation would succeed.

data.name: GroupBoundary
data.value: Entire captured forest, AD objects only. Direct entries and group-held entries linked by captured membership are included. SID history and implicit owner rights are not included. A membership chain or an Allow entry does not prove effective access.

data.name: DirectEntry
data.value: Direct entry: names the selected principal's SID.

data.name: SupportingLinks
data.value: Supporting captured membership links (routes do not multiply permission entries):

data.name: OneChain
data.value: One recorded chain is shown first; the supporting links below retain the other captured routes and cycles. This is not an effective access check.

data.name: MembershipChanged
data.value: The membership generation or delegation question changed. Start the search again.

data.name: MembershipIdentityMismatch
data.value: A saved membership identity does not match the protected captured evidence.

data.name: MembershipUnavailable
data.value: Group-held permission lookup is unavailable for this run. Uncheck Include group-held permissions to search direct entries only.

data.name: MembershipModeMismatch
data.value: The returned membership evidence does not match the requested direct/group-held search.

data.name: MembershipInvalid
data.value: The saved membership explanation cannot be read consistently.

data.name: NoGroupMatch
data.value: No matching recorded entries were found for these choices through the selected principal or the containing groups this capture establishes. Uncaptured or unresolved memberships and permissions, excluded inherited entries, SID history and implicit owner rights are not ruled out.

data.name: PrincipalPrompt
data.value: Search, then select the principal and its domain.

data.name: PrincipalNone
data.value: No captured user or group matches this search. This is not a statement about permissions; you can search by SID when its object was not captured.

data.name: CaptureShort
data.value: The run did not read all declared capture scope; uncaptured identities and permissions cannot be ruled out.

data.name: Cancelled
data.value: The search was cancelled. No complete answer is displayed.

data.name: Prompt
data.value: Select a principal and choose Find delegations. No search has been completed for these choices.

data.name: Page
data.value: Page {0}: {1} recorded entries on this page. {2}

data.name: NoMatch
data.value: No matching recorded entries were found for these choices. This does not rule out group-derived permissions, inherited entries when excluded, or permissions missing from the capture.

data.name: Coverage
data.value: Capture gaps: {0} objects with unreadable permissions; {1} objects with permissions not attempted; {2} incomplete descriptors; {3} recorded descriptor errors.

data.name: InheritedNote
data.value: Recorded on is where this entry was captured. For inherited entries it does not identify the ancestor that originally supplied it.

data.name: DomainSid
data.value: Domain-local SID: each result's resource domain is separate.
